---
title: "Indirect effect of influenza vaccination coverage on the circulation of respiratory viruses"
subtitle: "Supplementary Figure 11"
output: html_document
---
## Load packages and set plotting theme
```{r}
library(geofacet);library(sf);library(readr);
library(dplyr);library(ggplot2);library(tidyverse);library(RColorBrewer)
#setwd("/Users/yly/Desktop/vaccination-respiratory-viruses/04_Extended_analysis")
source("../plot_theme.R")
out_path1 <- paste0("FigS11")
dir.create(out_path1)
position <- read.csv("../00_data/lat_lon.csv")
colnames(position) <-c ("country","lon","lat")
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, England"),"country"] <- "UK, England"
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, Scotland"),"country"] <- "UK, Scotland"
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, Wales"),"country"] <- "UK, Wales"
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, Northern Ireland"),"country"] <- "UK, Northern Ireland"
```

## Prepare and save time series of AIVC 2016-2024
```{r eval=FALSE}
if (FALSE) {
dat1 <- read.csv("../00_data/multi_vaccine_cases_climate.csv")
dat1[which(dat1$country=="United Kingdom, England"),"country"] <- "UK, England"
dat1[which(dat1$country=="United Kingdom, Scotland"),"country"] <- "UK, Scotland"
dat1[which(dat1$country=="United Kingdom, Wales"),"country"] <- "UK, Wales"
dat1[which(dat1$country=="United Kingdom, Northern Ireland"),"country"] <- "UK, Northern Ireland"
dat1 <- dat1[,c("country","year_decimal","strategy2_general_coverage", "strategy2_coverage")]

# Save estimated monthly AIVC time-series data
saveRDS(dat1,"../00_data/ts_AIVC.rds",compress = "xz")
}
```

## Load saved data 
```{r}
dat1 <- readRDS("../00_data/ts_AIVC.rds")
```

## Plot
```{r fig.width=25, fig.height=15, dpi=300}
dat1$country <- factor(dat1$country,
                     levels = position$country[order(position$lat, decreasing = T)],ordered=TRUE)

p1<- ggplot(dat1, aes(x = year_decimal, y =strategy2_coverage ,group=1)) +
  geom_line(aes(x= year_decimal, y =strategy2_coverage,color = "Elderly population"),size=1,alpha=1)+
  geom_line(aes(x= year_decimal, y = strategy2_general_coverage, color = "General population"),size=1,alpha=1)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits =  c(2016,2025),expand = c(0, 0.5),
                     minor_breaks = seq(2016, 2024, by = 1/12),
                     breaks =c(2016, 2020,2024))+
  facet_wrap(~ country, scales = "free_x",nrow = 5) +
  
  labs(title = "",x = "Year",y = "Estimated monthly AIVC") +
  mytheme +
  theme(axis.title.y.left = element_text( margin = margin(0,0.4,0,0,'cm')))+
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"),
        panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.margin = unit(c(1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5), "cm")) + 
  scale_color_manual("",values = c( "General population" = "black","Elderly population" = "gray50"),
                        labels = c("AIVC among general population",
                                   "AIVC among elderly population")) + 
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=3,byrow = T))

p1

ggsave(p1,filename = file.path(paste0(out_path1,"/FigS11_AIVC.pdf",sep="")),
       bg = "white",width = 25,height =15,device   = cairo_pdf,  family   = "Arial")
```
